name: Play Button
summary: A round, semi-transparent button that plays or pauses video over an image.
description: A circular control that sits on top of a thumbnail or video frame, its fill translucent enough that the artwork underneath still shows through. Its triangle glyph sits a few pixels off true center, a deliberate correction since a perfectly centered triangle looks like it's leaning left.
whenToUse: Starting or resuming playback on a video thumbnail
Marking a piece of content as playable at a glance
whenNotToUse: Confirming a form or a general action — use a plain button instead
Labeling a control with visible text — this is icon-only, pair it with a caption elsewhere
dos: Pass a label describing what starts playing, for screen reader users.
Place it over image or video content. Its fill is translucent by design.
donts: Don't recenter the glyph to the button's exact middle. Keep the offset.
Don't use it without a label — it has no visible text of its own.

keyboard: Enter / Space activates, same as any button
notes: It has no visible text, so its accessible name comes entirely from the label — always set one that says what it plays.

states.hover: Fill brightens slightly to invite a click.
states.focus: An outline appears around the disc for keyboard focus.
